quick.title: Quick Evaluation
quick.description: Get a quick estimate of what you really earn per hour using just a few essential details about your job.

setup.title: Let's personalise your evaluation
setup.description: Choose what matters most to you. You can keep the default settings and start straight away.

balanced.title: Everything equally
balanced.description: Give Financial, Learning and Satisfaction equal importance.

setup.additionalAreasDescription: Both areas are included by default. Turn off anything you don't want to evaluate.
setup.priorityIncluded: Included because this is your main priority.
setup.financialTargetDescription: How much must you earn per hour for a job to meet your financial expectations?
setup.targetOptional: Optional. Leave empty if you don't have a target.
setup.invalidHourlyTarget: Enter a valid amount greater than zero.

financial.title: Financial
financial.description: Calculate what you really earn for the time you commit to this job.

period.label: Evaluation period
period.helper: Use the same period for all amounts and hours.

income.label: Take-home income
income.helper: Total income after taxes, including salary, bonuses, tips and commissions.

benefits.label: Additional benefits
benefits.helper: Optional. Estimated value of free meals, accommodation or other benefits.

expenses.label: Job-related expenses
expenses.helper: Optional. Travel, additional food, equipment and other costs caused by this job.

hours.label: Total committed hours
hours.helper: Include actual work, commuting and any required work at home.

validation.invalidAmount: Enter a valid amount using up to two decimal places.
validation.invalidHours: Enter a number of hours greater than zero.

learning.title: Learning and career growth
learning.description: Evaluate what this job offers for your professional development.

skillDevelopment.title: How much are you learning new skills?
skillDevelopment.helper: Consider skills that could also be useful in other jobs.

1.label: None
1.description: The job provides no meaningful opportunity to learn new skills.

2.label: Little
2.description: You occasionally learn something, but most tasks are repetitive.

3.label: Some
3.description: You learn some useful skills, but opportunities are inconsistent.

4.label: A lot
4.description: You regularly develop skills that are useful beyond this job.

5.label: Extensive
5.description: The job provides excellent opportunities to develop valuable and transferable skills.

careerRelevance.title: How relevant is this job to your career goals?
careerRelevance.helper: Consider experience, qualifications and future career opportunities.

1.label: Unrelated
1.description: The job has no meaningful connection to your career interests or future plans.

2.label: Slightly
2.description: The job offers very limited experience that could help your career.

3.label: Somewhat
3.description: The job provides some useful experience, but its relevance to your career is limited.

4.label: Relevant
4.description: The job provides valuable experience that supports your career direction.

5.label: Very relevant
5.description: The job strongly supports your career goals and provides highly relevant experience.

networking.title: How much opportunity do you have to meet useful professional contacts?
networking.helper: Think about people who could help you learn, develop or progress professionally.

1.label: None
1.description: You have virtually no opportunity to meet useful professional contacts.

2.label: Limited
2.description: You occasionally meet new people, but meaningful professional connections are unlikely.

3.label: Some
3.description: You have some opportunities to meet people who may be useful for your career.

4.label: Good
4.description: You regularly meet people who can offer useful professional connections.

5.label: Excellent
5.description: The job offers excellent opportunities to build valuable professional relationships.

academic.title: Academic requirements
academic.description: These answers provide additional context and don't affect your Learning score.
academic.credits: Does this job count towards required academic credits?
academic.curriculum: Do you need this job to fulfil a course or curriculum requirement?

validation.required: Please select a rating or Not applicable.

satisfaction.title: Job satisfaction
satisfaction.description: Evaluate your everyday working experience and wellbeing.

colleagues.title: How friendly and supportive are your colleagues?
colleagues.helper: Think about cooperation, respect and how people treat you at work.

1.label: Very poor
1.description: Interactions are often disrespectful or hostile, making it difficult to work comfortably.

2.label: Poor
2.description: Colleagues are rarely helpful or welcoming, and cooperation is limited.

3.label: Mixed
3.description: Some colleagues are supportive, but the overall experience is inconsistent.

4.label: Good
4.description: Colleagues are generally friendly, respectful and willing to help.

5.label: Excellent
5.description: Colleagues consistently create a welcoming, respectful and collaborative environment.

management.title: How supportive is the management?
management.helper: Consider communication, fairness, respect and availability when you need support.

1.label: Very poor
1.description: Management is often disrespectful, unavailable or unclear about expectations.

2.label: Poor
2.description: Support and communication are limited, and concerns are rarely addressed.

3.label: Mixed
3.description: Management is adequate at times, but support and communication are inconsistent.

4.label: Good
4.description: Management communicates clearly, treats people respectfully and provides support.

5.label: Excellent
5.description: Management is consistently respectful, approachable, fair and supportive.

workLifeBalance.title: How good is your work-life balance?
workLifeBalance.helper: Consider whether your working hours leave enough time for your personal life and responsibilities.

1.label: Very poor
1.description: Work regularly takes over your personal time, leaving little room for rest or other responsibilities.

2.label: Poor
2.description: Schedules or workload frequently interfere with your personal life.

3.label: Mixed
3.description: You can usually manage personal commitments, but work sometimes creates significant strain.

4.label: Good
4.description: Work generally fits around your personal life, with enough time to rest and manage other commitments.

5.label: Excellent
5.description: Working hours are predictable and leave you with a healthy balance and good control over your personal time.

stressManageability.title: How manageable is the stress and workload?
stressManageability.helper: Consider how often work feels overwhelming and whether you have enough support and recovery time.

1.label: Overwhelming
1.description: Stress feels constant and difficult to manage; workload regularly exceeds what you can handle.

2.label: High
2.description: Work often feels stressful, and it is difficult to recover between demanding periods.

3.label: Moderate
3.description: Stress is present but generally manageable, although busy periods can be challenging.

4.label: Manageable
4.description: Most demands are manageable, and you usually have enough support and recovery time.

5.label: Very manageable
5.description: Work rarely causes excessive stress; demands feel reasonable and well supported.

validation.required: Please select a rating or Not applicable.

overall.title: Your overall result
overall.targetMissing: Set a minimum hourly earnings target in your preferences to calculate your overall score.
overall.areaUnavailable: An included area has no applicable ratings. Exclude that area or provide an applicable rating.

share.title: Share your result
share.description: Share a summary of your job evaluation.
share.privacyNote: Hourly earnings are excluded by default to protect your financial privacy.
share.unavailable: Sharing is unavailable in this browser.

advanced.title: Advanced Evaluation
advanced.description: Get a more detailed picture of your work by considering income, expenses, working hours and additional factors.
